scene_frontend.theme_title: MiniMax H3 SAM3 Face Swap Tools

prompt.MiniMax H3 SAM3 Face Swap:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> (<Picture 1>): The replacement facial identity. Transfer facial shape, proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, age cues, and distinctive facial features only. Do not transfer reference background, pose, expression, lighting, hair, body, or clothing.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] Replace only the face selected by the SAM3 temporal mask with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. Preserve the source performance, unmasked content, and complete original soundtrack.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer - use only the facial identity of <Subject 1>.
Source video outside the SAM3 temporal mask: fully_preserved - preserve unselected faces, hair, body, clothing, background, camera movement, lighting, contact, and occlusion.
Source soundtrack: fully_copy - preserve all dialogue, ambience, music, and sound effects with their original timing.

detailed_description:
Preserve the source visual style, shot order, timing, and continuity. [Shot 1] Throughout the full source duration, replace only the SAM3-selected face with <Subject 1>. Keep the source expression timing, gaze, blinking, lip movement, mouth shape, head pose, scene-relative scale, motion path, and occlusion. Keep every unselected person and all unmasked content unchanged. Frames without a selected region remain unchanged. Camera: Preserve the source framing, movement, focus, amplitude, and speed. Dialogue and visible text: Preserve existing dialogue and text; add none. Synchronized sound: Preserve the complete source soundtrack and lip synchronization.

overall_soundscape:
Fully preserve the original dialogue, ambience, music, and sound effects in exact synchronization.

non_diegetic_music:
Preserve the existing non-diegetic music; if none exists, N/A.

agent_prompt.MiniMax H3 SAM3 Face Swap: You are the MiniMax H3 SAM3 face-swap prompt generator. Produce a complete Ref2VA prompt in the required six-section English format. The source video is supplied only as the initial masked AV latent and as analysis-only visual evidence; it is not a numbered H3 reference, so never name it as <Video N>. The SAM3 temporal mask, crop coordinates, and stitch data are execution data, not reference media. Analysis-only source-video contact sheets may contain a translucent red overlay marking the user's selected region; identify that region across time, but never generate the red overlay. <Picture 1> defines <Subject 1>, the replacement facial identity. Replace only the face selected by SAM3. Do not select another face, replace the whole person, or transfer reference hair, body, clothing, pose, background, or lighting. Preserve source expression timing, gaze, blinking, lip movement, mouth shape, head pose, scene-relative scale, motion path, contact, and occlusion. Preserve every unselected face and all unmasked content, camera movement, composition, lighting, and the complete source soundtrack. Frames without a selection remain unchanged. Use source visuals only to describe existing performance and scene context; never copy the source identity into <Subject 1>. In retention_analysis, use attribute_transfer for the reference identity. Do not invent new cuts, actions, dialogue, visible text, or sounds. Use the exact runtime duration.
